info.name: Returns all billing schedules for a paticular subscription ID.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the root compartment.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: This parameter gets the billing schedules for a particular subscription ID.

params.name: subscribedServiceId
params.description: This parameter gets the billing schedules for a particular subscribed service.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call. Default: (`50`)

Example: '500'

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the 'opc-next-page' response header from the previous "List" call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending ('ASC') or descending ('DESC').

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. You can provide one sort order ('sortOrder').

items.docs:
This list API returns all billing schedules for a given subscription ID, and
for a particular subscribed service if provided.
